before.requirement: Free the allocated parser before returning after a reported add-string parse error.
before.reason: ucl_parser_free releases the parser and its state, while the harness returns before calling it on a reported error. The missing chunk delegate prevents confirmation that this branch is input-reachable.

after.requirement: Free the allocated parser before returning after a reported add-string parse error.
after.reason: ucl_parser_free also releases a pending comment after the change. The same harness branch still bypasses it, but the missing chunk delegate prevents confirmation of an input-reachable reported error.

claims.reason: On both versions, the same early return bypasses ucl_parser_free whenever ucl_parser_get_error is non-null. The missing delegate leaves the trigger unconfirmed on both sides.
